title: helianthemum oelandicum var. italicum
intro: Helianthemum oelandicum var. italicum, commonly known as Rockrose or Alpine Rose, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues, including stress, anxiety, and inflammation, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum oelandicum var. italicum include its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable remedy for soothing muscle cramps and promoting better sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and are responsible for its medicinal effects.
